[[Your Child (DS)|Possible child]] |rival = |wife lunches = |unlock by =The first two mines must be unlocked before the third. |appearances ='''DS, Cute''' }} {{Nihongo|Keira|キララ|Kirara}} is a special bachelorette in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]]'' and best friend only in the Japanese version of [[Harvest Moon DS: Cute|''Cute'']]. Keira cannot speak due to a curse put on her by the [[Witch Princess (DS)|Witch Princess]], even after the player marries her. She will communicate by writing on a board instead. If they get married, the sign in Keira's room will say that she's happy. The player will meet Keira on the final level of the second mine, where she gives them the Legendary Sword. From then on, she is found on the 255th floor of the third mine. When they meet each other for her heart events, Keira will be seen sleeping in her bed. Although Keira is always sleeping, the player can even still give her gifts, and there is a sign with instructions for her heart events. All of her heart events are "fetch" type events, asking the player to give her a specific gift. The floor that Keira sleeps on will be empty, the soil already tilled, except for the bed and the sign. ==Gifts[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/keira.php Keira Likes/Dislikes] fogu.com== {{Infobox Gift |special =Golden Lumber |loved =Alexandrite, Diamond, Mythic, Pink Diamond, Seasonal Sun (All) |liked =Mystrile, Orihalcon, Adamantite, Moonstone, Sandrose, Emerald, Ruby, Topaz, Peridot, Flourite, Agate, Amethyst, Ultimate Curry, Finest Curry, Relax Tea, Relax Tea Leaves |neutral =''Other items not listed'' |disliked =Dog Ball, Flowers, Lumber, Material Stone, Wool |hated =Bamboo Shoot, Bird Feed, Boot, Branch, Colored Grasses, Cooked Dishes (except those listed in "Liked"), Crops, Curry Powder, Dairy products, Dumpling Powder, Empty Can, Fish (All), Fish Bones, Fish Fossil, Flour, Fodder, Fruits, Mushrooms, Oil, Stone, Toadstool, Weed, Wild Grape |horror = Rice Ball }} ==Heart Events[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/keira.php Keira Heart Events] fogu.com == Although all of Keira's heart events ask you to bring Keira something, it is not the same as giving her a gift that she likes, meaning you can trigger the event and still bring her something to raise affection points. Every heart event basically dropping down to the 255th floor, reading the sign, and bringing her something she wants hinted by it. If you read the following information, you can skip the extra trip by bringing what she wants the first time you drop down. '''Black Heart Event''' Keira's black heart event triggers when you climb up to the 255th floor of the third mine for the first time. You will find the sleeping princess in her bed in the middle and a sign by her bed. The sign prompts you to bring her a curry (Ultimate or Finest Curry only). The event ends with the player leaves that dish by the sign as they come back. {{Clr}} ---- '''Purple Heart Event''' Keira is at a purple heart or higher, proven that her black heart event has been viewed. The sign will say "I'm thirsty" this time, and you need to bring her Relax Tea. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event''' Keira is at a blue heart or higher, proven that her purple heart event has been viewed. The sign will read "I want precious stones now. Well. Bring me [a/an] [Random Stone]." You have to make two trips this time, since the stone she requests will vary for each game. {{Clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event''' Keira is at a yellow heart or higher, proven that her previous heart events have been viewed. The sign will say "I love Gold Lumber. Bring them." This event ends as you do what it says. ==References== {{reflist|2}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Bachelorettes]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]]
